rule: This file is written BEFORE any FO result exists. Nothing in it may be changed after an FO number has been computed. If a defect is found later, it is recorded as an amendment with its date and reason, never as a silent edit.

documented_edits_only.temain_mod.f:346-360: output paths (the header sanctions this edit)
documented_edits_only.teprob.f:1256-1296: XNS scaled by noise_scale for the noise-level axis only

source.not_touched: physics, controllers, disturbance definitions, noise model structure

disturbances.normal_operation: IDV=0, generated once per seed as the PAIRED baseline
disturbances.rationale: all 21 are used, including the near-undetectable 3, 9 and 15. Dropping the hard faults would remove exactly the regime FO claims to diagnose.

seeds.generation: seed = 1000000000 + 7919 * i, i = 0..49, frozen list below
seeds.budget: 2100 simulator runs at 1.55 s/run, measured -> approx. 54 minutes
seeds.independence_unit: one (disturbance, seed) realisation. A TIME STEP IS NOT AN EXPERIMENT: the 800 post-fault samples of a realisation share one seed, one fault and one trajectory, and are treated as within-unit repeated measures only.

splits.split_by: SEED, never by scenario -- splitting by scenario would put the same noise realisation on both sides
splits.test_is_touched: once, at the very end, after every threshold is frozen

channels.reason: XNS declares a measurement-noise standard deviation for the 41 XMEAS and for nothing else. XMV are controller outputs with no declared measurement noise, so including them would require an invented sigma -- which the brief forbids.

delta.definition: delta[z, j, t] = XMEAS_fault[z, t, j] - XMEAS_normal[z, t, j], same seed, post-fault samples 160..959
delta.why_this_is_not_invented: at equal seed the normal and faulted runs are BIT-IDENTICAL before the fault time (verified, max|diff| = 0.000e+00) and diverge only after. This is a true paired counterfactual, exactly FO's 'deviation caused by the event'.

sigma.definition: XNS(1..41), the process's own declared per-channel measurement standard deviation, read from teprob.f:1256-1296
sigma.cross_check: the empirical lag-1 noise on normal operation agrees with the declared values to a median ratio of 1.03; the declared array is used, the empirical estimate is only a sanity check

fo_inputs.kappa_rationale: chosen on the 21x3 pilot BEFORE any diagnosis outcome existed, to put |E*| near 0.79 of the scenarios -- selective at both ends. Measured selectivity: kappa 1 -> 0.952, 10 -> 0.905, 30 -> 0.794, 100 -> 0.667, 300 -> 0.492, 1000 -> 0.159.
fo_inputs.support_frozen_from: TRAIN seeds only, at nominal noise (noise_scale = 1.0)

sensor_designs.selection: uniform without replacement under seed 20260816, drawn BEFORE any FO or classifier result
sensor_designs.note: designs are frozen as an explicit list before the run, not resampled per analysis

noise_axis.meaning: XNS scaled by the factor; data REGENERATED at that physical noise level, and sigma_eval scaled to match
noise_axis.verified: at scale 8 the B_dynamic support collapsed 16 -> 4 while the B* support stayed at 16, so B* exercises its distinguishing property on this benchmark

inferrer.role: independent observer; it never sees FO, and FO never sees it
inferrer.task: 21-class disturbance identification from the channels in design S, post-fault window only
inferrer.features: per-channel mean, std, min, max, and last value over the post-fault window, computed on S only

fo_diagnostic_endpoints: AUROC of d_S(z) for predicting top-1 failure, with 95% CI
AUPRC of d_S(z) for the same
Spearman of d_S(z) with log_loss, with rank_of_true_class, and with reciprocal_rank
calibration of B*(S) against the observed failure rate on E*
failure rate per decile of d_S(z)
endpoints.aggregation: per (disturbance, seed) realisation; never per time step

simple_baselines_fo_must_beat: mean |delta| / sigma over S (plain SNR, no max, no threshold)
count of channels in S exceeding 3 sigma
smallest singular value of the standardised delta matrix restricted to S
number of channels in S (a pure design-size control)

success_criteria.FO_SUPPORTED: on TEST, the AUROC of d_S(z) for top-1 failure has a 95% CI whose lower bound exceeds 0.5, AND its point estimate exceeds every simple baseline above, AND the CI lower bound exceeds the point estimate of the best simple baseline
success_criteria.FO_INCONCLUSIVE: the TEST set yields fewer than 30 reconstruction failures or fewer than 30 successes, making the AUROC CI uninformative
success_criteria.B_star_specific: B*(S) must be compared to B_dynamic(S) across the four noise levels; the claim that B* is the repaired metric is upheld only if B*'s denominator stays fixed while B_dynamic's moves, on the real regenerated data

stopping_rules: The test split is opened exactly once. No threshold, no kappa, no eta, no design list and no hyperparameter may change afterwards.

If the inferrer's TRAIN accuracy is below 0.30 on the full 41-channel design, the inferrer is declared unfit and the phase stops before FO is computed -- a diagnostic of failure is meaningless when the observer fails everywhere.
If |E*| on TRAIN is 0 or equals the full train set, the support is degenerate, kappa was misjudged, and the phase stops rather than being re-tuned.
If FO_INCONCLUSIVE triggers, the verdict is INCONCLUSIVE and no favourable reading is reported.
No FO variant, no FO-v2, no formula change is permitted at any point. If FO fails, it is reported as failing.
explicitly_forbidden: treating a time step as an independent experiment
selecting kappa, eta or a design after seeing diagnosis outcomes
reporting a subset of disturbances chosen after the fact
